title: Rent Discount Programs and Lease Term Agreement Concession Recapture
content:
The concession recapture booked on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement keeps a partnership share of the unearned concession. The partnership share is set by the lease's ongoing rent discount program: a lease on the active military discount keeps 25 percent; a lease on the preferred employer discount keeps 50 percent; a lease with no discount program keeps the whole.

The rent discount program is the ongoing program recorded on the Apartment Home Lease, fixed at lease signing; a lease is enrolled in at most one.

| Rent discount program on the Apartment Home Lease | Partnership share kept |
|---|---|
| Active military discount | 25 percent (0.25) |
| Preferred employer discount | 50 percent (0.50) |
| No discount program | the whole (100 percent) |

The share multiplies the unearned concession, and no figure is rounded before the recapture itself.

*Illustrations (hypothetical).* An unearned concession of 500.00 dollars on a lease enrolled in the active military discount keeps 125.00 dollars; on the preferred employer discount, 250.00 dollars; with no program, 500.00 dollars.
